services.value: Provides OLCC Licensed / ORELAP Accredited / CTS Compliant cannabis testing and analysis for recreational cannabis, medical cannabis, and industrial hemp. Tests include cannabinoid potency, minor cannabinoids, terpenes, pesticides, residual solvents, heavy metals, microbial mycotoxins, moisture content, and water activity using GC-MS, ICP-MS, LC-MS, QPCR, and HPLC.
